By adding the call to `generateNASAThermoData()`, the patch ensures that the NASA polynomials are updated accordingly, thus maintaining consistency between the species name and its associated thermo data. This change directly resolves the issue introduced in a previous commit (7339cc176cc7bbc671f4dec65b2f161d351ea270).
